g.text: (payment succeeded, Order Service down for 30 s)
[backoff 100 ms → 200 ms → … max 5 s (up to 25 attempts)]
INSERT orders ON CONFLICT (reservation_id) DO NOTHING
No paid order is lost: (1) payment + event commit atomically,
(2) Kafka retains the event, (3) consumer is idempotent,
(4) reconciler alerts on any "paid without order".
